facts.text: Through the CSP Pell Commitment, eligible students can earn an on-campus undergraduate degree with full tuition covered after the Federal Pell Grant and Minnesota State Grant have been applied.

facts.text: The Church Work Tuition Guarantee provides free tuition to all students preparing for full-time church work vocations.
